review_scope: A3 static Core/account/payment/recovery subreview only; actual new clean package from the fixed remote ZIP; text/AST trace, no package imported or executed.

checks.detail: Extracted Core and welcome bytes equal the fixed ZIP members; slug/version/channel/base are this product, business product remains gemini.

checks.check: First turn is telemetry plus local persistence
checks.detail: No business call or account read on first-turn; telemetry and local state errors are best effort. Account words return accountIntent. Explicit no-photo image requests now infer has_need while greetings do not require the flag.

checks.check: Original identity and account input validation
checks.detail: Invalid persisted identity fails rather than silently creating a replacement. A valid original install_secret is retained; a new secret is generated only when no original identity exists.

Exact HTTPS first-party host/path and userinfo rejection; preserve query/fragment, normalize legacy input toward myplanestore.com, positive non-bool expiry. Expired links retried at most once using original identity.

Body has exactly prompt,size,confirmed,image_engine,references,reference_consent; actual True confirmations; only three supported sizes; one PNG/JPEG reference; bounded raw read and source digest; no model/n/quality additions.

Locks first; otherwise _void_unsubmitted persists three consents false, clears key/job/body/source/prompt/look and task billing, saves B path and replanning before scene/look/eligibility/text/file checks. Unknown/no/bad B cannot retain A authorization.

checks.check: Three consents and immutable planned prompt/look
checks.detail: Successful plan stores prompt_snapshot and look_snapshot; confirm only planned adult-self and unchanged source SHA, independent yes flags. run requires all three actual booleans; outgoing body uses frozen prompt, not rebuilt theme defaults.

checks.check: Submit journal and unknown generation GET-only
checks.detail: Persist submit_unknown/body digest/body_recipe before the only generation POST. Timeout, 409/5xx, invalid response/id and GET404 preserve key and task; recovery reads original by-key/job/image, never reposts generation.

Key saved unbound then bound is True required. Binding401 removes only key/bound, retains install identity and draft. Submitted401 restores original account identity and queries original task; persistent failure exits4/task_kept, no new task key.

checks.check: 402 and regenerate stay within consent/identity boundaries
checks.detail: Definitive insufficient balance keeps original task and asks before topup. Resume prevalidates local reference before account calls. Regenerate only finished states plus renewed pay consent and preserved owner/upload consents.

New plan and regenerate clear charged_uses,reserved_uses,remaining_after_submit. Current nonnegative exact-int response values only; absence remains unknown, existing locked-task values retained, no inferred charge1.
Only explicit pending/processing without uncertainty notice proves processing; missing/unknown/review status or errors remain unconfirmed. Failure says fees from records; no new generation POST.

Main resets once; nested resume/run share budget. Six combined by-key/id reads, two image reads, four account requests, query/download windows120 and overall420 monotonic. Budget passed to http_bytes.request; this subreview does not execute HTTP worker or repeat deadline tests.

checks.check: Read-only image recovery and safe delivery
checks.detail: Read original image only, bounded PNG verification including CRC/zlib before non-overwrite output. Download failure saves download_pending; dimensions reported as actual; output balance exact-int and charges from task response only.

status/auth/topup/paid/balance/history use original quick-entry/membership short-link paths or factual failure, without generating. Account state/registered/remaining balance does not establish a new order payment.
cmd_auth has no task context but its error branch calls failure(...,not_started), producing a false assertion that an existing unknown image never started or charged.

checks.check: History and ticket views use factual owner-scoped records
checks.detail: Paging based on returned total; sanitizes record text and uses received charge/reserve/refund fields. Ticket known-id path is GET-only, checks returned id, handles404 without claiming access; absent due time not fabricated.

Feedback body/key saved before POST; malformed/unknown response keeps pending. A known ticket is queried rather than resubmitted; no invented support by-key endpoint. Queue dispatch exception is RC19.

checks.check: Unknown old feedback must not piggyback a new submission
checks.detail: New feedback B with args.retry=False appends B then submits the whole pending list, including previously unknown A, although the user only confirmed B. auto_retry=False signals do not prevent that old A repost in this branch.

findings.title: Generic auth failure asserts an unknown image was not charged
findings.input: An original image remains submit_unknown (or was settled but not yet confirmed). User asks to re-authorize; quick-entry fails with network/HTTP error.
findings.expected: State only that this account operation failed, authorization itself costs no image use, and original image fees remain determined by service records.
findings.actual: studio.py:999 passes not_started to welcome_copy.failure; the final message asserts no generation started and no uses were charged, although cmd_auth never reads a draft.
findings.suggested_fix: In a development version, use the safe account_failure or record-context wording for this no-draft branch. Retain original task/key and do not alter the frozen1.0.0 artifact.

findings.title: New feedback submits an old unknown pending item without explicit continuation
findings.input: Feedback A was POSTed but its response was lost, so A remains pending. User later explicitly confirms a distinct new feedback B without requesting to continue A.
findings.expected: Submit B only; retain A with its original body/key until the user explicitly asks to continue that unknown feedback.
findings.actual: cmd_feedback args.retry=False appends B, then _submit_pending iterates all pending items and rePOSTs A before B; auto_retry=False on the later signal does not stop the action.
findings.suggested_fix: In development, distinguish the currently confirmed new item from old unknown pending items; only an explicit retry operation may resume the relevant old pending feedback with the same body/key.
